   - `PumpEnd::Exited` logs the child exit, then `log_self_exit(0, None)`, exit 0;
   - `WorkerPanicked` logs the child exit, then `log_self_exit(1, Some("internal-error"))`, exit 1.

**Ref:** .andromeda/runs/2026-11-24T23-29-11Z-wrap/

- cli: no interactive prompt, pager or redraw, and input is stdin / `--file` only; tui: once the child starts the terminal belongs to the child, and viola writes zero bytes of its own to it (only a start's automatic verify lines L1 to L5 and verify's own output precede the child's bytes, and only a not-resumed `viola adopt`'s refusal pair or document follows them once the child ends) (under `viola revive --json` or `viola adopt --json` a `pump_child` error prints no document: viola writes nothing past it, and a peer the wrapper refuses is dropped in `accept_loop`, before its worker thread and any frame: it writes nothing to the outer terminal and moves no wheel), and once the wrapped child holds the terminal, human keystrokes are never blocked, refused or dropped: queued with the paste in arrival order, they wait behind at most its in-flight chunk and closing marker (the one exception is a start's automatic verify window, before the child starts: a key typed then waits in the terminal's own buffer), and focus / mouse / resize sequences and terminal replies (F-W2's closed list) are never counted as editing; every other byte is. viola has no web or graphical frontend; the terminal fleet console's keyboard reach is the route entry «Fleet a11y verification»'s.

- CLI exit codes: 0 · 1 (a `cli` verb's internal error: `error: internal error` on stderr, or under `--json` before a `--` the catch site's `{"v":1,"error":"internal-error","detail":null}` on stdout, stderr then empty, `run`, `revive`'s start, `adopt`'s start, `mcp` and `hook` silent at that site; also `viola run`'s and `viola revive`'s start, and `viola verify`, refusing the home tree before any log opens: the home-state `unable:` / `hint:` pair, or the instance-state pair for an instance-level refusal, no line written, no child started; also `viola run`'s, `viola revive`'s and `viola adopt`'s start refusing the socket directory (`socket_dir_ready`, before any snapshot, child or `Server::bind`; a failed create and a refused check read this one code, a `Server::bind` failure does not): the stderr `unable:` / `hint:` pair, or under `viola revive --json` the `socket-dir-refused` document, and one `process-exit{subject:"self", exit_code:1, detail:"socket-dir-refused"}`, no path, pid or uid; `viola verify`'s refusals each carry their code on the `process-exit` it writes under a parsed `VIOLA_NAME`: `program-not-found` · `pinned-hash-mismatch` · `version-unreadable` · `strict-modes-failed` · `unclean-fixture`, beside `interrupted`; a failing row is no refusal and carries no code, yet `viola verify` still exits 1 on a failed relied row with that row's stamp written, and `verify` takes no `--json`; also `viola open`'s refusals, `strict-modes-failed` before any log, `already-live`, `stale-heartbeat`, `pinned-hash-mismatch`, `terminal-not-found`, `not-live` or `internal-error`, each under `--json` the `{"v":1,"error":"<code>","detail":null}` document; also `viola adopt`'s refusals, under `--json` one refusal document whose `<code>` is one of `strict-modes-failed` · `session-live` · `not-resumed` · `already-live` · `stale-heartbeat` · `pinned-hash-mismatch` · `squatted-name` · `socket-dir-refused` · `internal-error` (`session-live` when a `claude agents --json` row carries the adopted id); also `viola focus`'s and `viola up`'s refusals, each an `unable:` / `hint:` pair on stderr with no path, or under `--json` one refusal document (`viola up`'s `boot-time-unread`, `strict-modes-failed`, `pinned-hash-mismatch` or `terminal-not-found`); also a `viola up` whose lines are not all successes) · 2 (usage error, and `viola send` text over 16 MiB or not UTF-8) · 10 human-typing · 11 unassigned (the retired `budget-paused` refusal's code, never reused or renumbered) · 12 unverified-cli · 13 not-delivered · 14 unknown · 20 wrapper fault (a `-32602` from `link` / `unlink` included) · 21 instance unreachable (under `--json` `{"v":1,"error":"instance-unreachable","detail":"<cause>"}`, written by `client::unreachable_document` (the board builds its own), `<cause>` one of the six exit-21 words of `viola_core::UnreachableCause`'s closed seven (the seventh, `call-deadline`, written by the MCP frame tools alone) `strict-modes-failed` · `instance-dead` · `unwrapped-name` · `endpoint-lost` · `server-verify-failed` · `socket-dir-refused`, no `RefusalReason`; with no live endpoint `viola_state::liveness::without_endpoint` reads an instance directory as `instance-dead` and anything else as `unwrapped-name`, so a stale instance reads `instance-dead`, and a wrapper lost with the call open reads `endpoint-lost`; also, on `send` / `wait` / `last` / `answer` / `pause` / `release` / `link` / `unlink`, a server that is not the recorded wrapper — a connected peer whose euid is not this user's or cannot be read (`peer_admitted`), or the connected peer's pid or OS start time not the snapshot's, or that check not made — no frame written, `{"v":1,"error":"instance-unreachable","detail":"server-verify-failed"}` under `--json` (Linux only; the Windows and macOS legs left with their code, recoverable at the tag `multi-os-final`), after the client's own exit-13 refusals, the strict-modes instance check and the socket-directory check, with no exit code or `RefusalReason` of its own, its `--json` word the document's `detail`; also `viola list`'s refused strict-modes check of the home, `instances/` or any one instance, which refuses the whole board, no log opened, and `viola up`'s same board refusal (`instance-unreachable`, `strict-modes-failed`), with no line printed; also `viola focus`'s refused strict-modes check: the `unable:` / `hint:` pair, or `{"v":1,"error":"instance-unreachable","detail":"strict-modes-failed"}` under `--json` with stderr empty, nothing under the home opened and no line written; and `viola plugin install`'s refused strict-modes check of the home or an existing `marketplace/` tree dir, nothing created, no log opened; and the refused instance check of `send` / `wait` / `last` / `answer` / `pause` / `release` (the target instance) and of `viola link` / `viola unlink` (the driven instance), made first by `client::refuse_untrusted` (`check_instance` on the home and `instances/<name>`, after `send`'s text read, before any connect, role file or log opens): the instance-state `unable:` / `hint:` pair, or `{"v":1,"error":"instance-unreachable","detail":"strict-modes-failed"}` under `--json`, no log opened, no line written; and, on those same eight verbs, past that check and before any connect, a refused socket directory on the recorded endpoint (`check_endpoint_dir` in `client::connect`): the socket-directory hint last on stderr, or `{"v":1,"error":"instance-unreachable","detail":"socket-dir-refused"}` under `--json`, one `process-exit` at WARN with `during` `connect` and no `channel-request`); `viola hook` always 0. `viola revive` exits 0, 1 for a refused strict-modes check (ahead of the wrapper log: the stderr pair, no log line) or a preflight refusal (`already-live` or `stale-heartbeat` · `no-session` · `session-live` · `cwd-missing`, read in that order, each one `process-exit` line) or a refusal of the start after a passed preflight, or 2 for a usage error; it takes `--json` on both arms, where a refused strict-modes check and every refusal of its start is instead one stdout document `{"v":1,"error":"<code>","detail":null}` (`strict-modes-failed` · `already-live` · `no-session` · `session-live` · `cwd-missing` · `stale-heartbeat` · `pinned-hash-mismatch` · `squatted-name` · `socket-dir-refused` · `internal-error`, by `client::refused_document`; a `claude` not on `PATH` or an anyhow error of the start is `internal-error`), stderr empty, exit 1, and `<name> --list --json` prints `{"v":1,"ok":{"sessions":[…]}}` in log order (a `pump_child` error prints no document: the child has held the terminal).

The only crate that knows Claude Code (test-only exceptions: the live rig in `viola-e2e` reads the key names and the source word of its own captured UserPromptSubmit payload and the cachedChromeExtensionInstalled key name, never a value, and its own captured StopFailure payload's key names, error word (one of the CLI's 13, else `other`) and two text lengths, never a text, and seeds its private Claude config; VH reads the real config's key names and a needle, never a value; the fake agent and the rig read a config's trust record). It parses hook payloads tolerantly and maps each hook to a normalised kind. It maps dialog answers to decision bodies (S3 / S7 / S8) and applies the R8 `CLAUDE*` strip. It resolves the child program (`resolve_program`: a given path as given, a bare name on `PATH`) and holds the Claude-specific half of the CLI version gate: the capability ledger rows (compiled) with their `viola verify` checks, `parse_version`, the stamp merge and `verified` verdict, and the fixture scrub. The gate's spawn is the root bin's `run::version_gate`; the stamps I/O is `viola_state::stamps`. It keeps the vt100 screen signatures (readiness gate), parses, in the pure `agents` module, a `claude agents --json` answer (`parse` into rows or a closed `AgentsFailure`, `oversize` · `malformed`; the read itself is the root bin's `run::agents`), and normalises `prompt-submitted` (removes the long-paste wrapper, then reverses tag escaping; classifies `origin` human/harness; the wrapper sets `driver` only on the in-flight send's own prompt and relabels a CLI-fired scheduled wake `harness`). It also holds the resume shapes `viola revive`, `viola adopt` and a `viola switch` respawn launch with (`viola verify`'s Run E is the second caller of `resume_args(id, false)`): `PROGRAM` (`claude`), `RESUME_FLAG`, `FORK_SESSION_FLAG`, `is_session_id` (36 characters, hyphens at offsets 8, 13, 18, 23, ASCII hex elsewhere) and `resume_args(id, fork)`; it is the one product home of the four flag literals `--resume`, `--fork-session`, `--model` and `--effort` (`MODEL_FLAG`, `EFFORT_FLAG`; `viola adopt`'s fixed `not-resumed` hint names `claude --resume <id>` only as words for the human to type, never as an argument viola passes), and holds `DEFAULT_PAIR`, the one compiled default model and effort pair, with the five effort words of `claude --help`; no environment variable sets the pair. It also holds the pure `marketplace` module, `viola plugin install`'s three documents built by `serde_json` (`marketplace_files`; `NAME` the marketplace `viola`, `PLUGIN_REF` `viola@viola`; its `.mcp.json` registers the MCP server `viola`, no hooks). No adapter trait yet: a second agent arrives as a sibling `viola-agent-<name>` crate, at which point the adapter trait is extracted into `viola-core`.

- Exit codes: 0 ok · 1 internal / a `run` start refusal (its refused home-tree check before the wrapper log included: the home or the instance pair, no log, no child; its refused socket directory too, `socket_dir_ready` before any snapshot, child or `Server::bind`: the `unable:` / `hint:` pair, or under `viola revive --json` the `socket-dir-refused` document, and one `process-exit{subject:"self", exit_code:1, detail:"socket-dir-refused"}`, no path, pid or uid, a failed create reading the same code and a `Server::bind` failure not), a `revive` strict-modes, home-tree, preflight, socket-directory or start refusal, a `viola adopt` refusal (`strict-modes-failed` before any log, `session-live`, `not-resumed` (under `--json` its document printed after the child released the terminal), `already-live`, `stale-heartbeat`, `pinned-hash-mismatch`, `squatted-name`, `socket-dir-refused` or `internal-error`, each under `--json` its refusal document), a `viola focus` refusal other than its strict-modes check (an unable and hint pair, or under --json one refusal document), a `viola up` refusal other than its board scan's strict-modes check (`boot-time-unread`, `strict-modes-failed`, `pinned-hash-mismatch` or `terminal-not-found`;
